clauses.clause: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
clauses.evidence: Every cast asks sacrifice: [you_bear, you_giant] (your creatures only) and moves the chosen one to the graveyard (by card/SACRIFICE) before 'you casts card'; cost B-1. Pack bone_splinters_1 PASS: with no creature to sacrifice the cast is refused (cost:sacrifice:insufficient_candidates), an artifact is no candidate; it fails against the tree without the cost.

target slot (cast): 1..1 of the six creatures; [cast targets=['opp_giant']] opp_giant moves to the graveyard (by card/DESTROY); [cast targets=['you_bear']] sacrificing you_bear itself: no destroy, the spell just goes to the graveyard (its only target is gone, CR 608.2b).
